expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the first milestone (run a command via re-exec) with TODOs, not the full runtime with cgroups/networking
expectations.evidence: README.md roadmap: '- [x] **M1 — UTS namespace**' followed by unchecked '- [ ] M2 — PID namespace' through '- [ ] M7 — User namespace' (TODOs). Code implements only M1 re-exec: container_linux.go 'exec.Command("/proc/self/exe", append([]string{"child"}, args...)...)' with 'Cloneflags: syscall.CLONE_NEWUTS'; no cgroup or network code anywhere.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with concrete commands and expected behaviour: 'docker build -t tinydocker .' / 'docker run --rm --cap-add SYS_ADMIN tinydocker run sh' / '# inside: hostname  ->  tinydocker', plus 'run `hostname` on the host before and after — it stays unchanged while the container reports `tinydocker`'.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions that namespaces/cgroups are Linux-only so a Linux machine/VM with root is required for later milestones
expectations.evidence: Answer: 'namespaces are Linux-only; Docker CLI isn't on this Mac, so use Docker Desktop or a Linux box'. README.md: 'Namespaces are Linux-only. From macOS, run the project inside a Linux environment (Docker Desktop, a Linux VM, or a Linux server)' and '### Option B: Linux box / VM, as root' with 'sudo ./tinydocker run sh'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but the single shell command writes outside the project dir: 'go build -o /tmp/td-darwin .' and 'CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -o /tmp/td-linux-arm64 .' / 'GOARCH=amd64 go build -o /tmp/td-linux-amd64 .' place binaries in /tmp, outside the workspace.
